crop.notes: Whole 'The Ring' item about Allen's birthday.

ocr.notes: Small slips: 'said Tom' should be 'said he'; 'Tom and his two are all' drops 'daughters'; 'banquet yesterday' drops 'morning'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen celebrated his birthday with friends at his Market Street saloon, recalling St. George's Day in England in 1882 and saying both his daughters were married.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday, April 24, 1892, page 6. 'Yesterday' makes the birthday April 23, 1892.

facts.fact: Allen celebrated his birthday, St. George's Day, with friends at his headquarters on Market Street, St. Louis
Allen said he was in England in 1882 and took part in the St. George's Day celebrations
facts.quote: In the old country it is known also as St. George's Day and I tell you they celebrate it in royal style. When I was over there in 1882 I had the pleasure of participating, and it was one of the happiest periods of my life.

facts.fact: Allen said both of his daughters were married, one living in England and the other caring for him at home in St. Louis
facts.quote: Both of my girls are married; one of them resides in the old country and the other endeavors to make my last days comfortable at home,

notes: Allen's quote says Shakespeare was born and died on 'the 22d of April'; transcribed as printed in the image.
